analyst_view.overall: Early view: second-from-bottom Valencia have taken 2 of 21 points at Mestalla under Javier Aguirre, and the mood was tense after the 0-3 defeat to Real Madrid. Gayà's red card (one match, served at Rayo) and Moncayola's five-yellow ban (served against Málaga) should both be over by this game, despite what the brief lists. Osasuna (16th) have been poor away, losing at Deportivo and Sevilla.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. Valencia's home attack has hardly worked (four shots against Madrid), and Osasuna away have scored little; both sides near the bottom will be wary of losing. I lean towards one or two goals.

corners.text: The site expects 9.3 corners and I am close. Osasuna's wide crossing game produces corners, but Aguirre's deep 5-3-2 gives Valencia few of their own, so the two roughly balance.

cards.text: The model has 4.8 cards and I lean higher. Valencia committed 26 fouls and took five cards against Madrid, Osasuna committed 19 fouls against Athletic, and with Mestalla impatient, five or six cards is likely.

shots.text: The site expects 25.9 shots. Aguirre's Valencia generate very little (four shots at home to Real Madrid), and Osasuna's away attack has been flat. Low 20s looks right.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.5 on target. Neither side creates much clear-cut, and Umar Sadiq, Valencia's main target man, took a knock against Madrid. Six on target seems more likely.
